name: GE 7.4 Cu. Ft. Smart Electric Dryer with Sanitize Cycle
description: Upgrade your laundry routine with this high-capacity, feature-packed GE smart electric dryer! Boasting a massive 7.4 cu. ft. capacity aluminized alloy drum, it easily handles heavy bedding, bulky towels, and king-size comforters. Equipped with HE Sensor Dry dual-thermistor technology to prevent over-drying, an anti-bacterial Sanitize Cycle that kills 99.8% of common household bacteria, and an extended Wrinkle Care tumble system to keep clothes crisp and crease-free. Built-in Wi-Fi connectivity lets you monitor cycle status remotely through the SmartHQ app. Features a flat-back space-saving design and a reversible door hinge to effortlessly adapt to any laundry room layout. Exceptionally quiet, highly energy-efficient, and runs flawlessly!
contact_note: Fully tested, deeply cleaned, and in perfect working order. Please ensure you have a standard 240V 3-wire or 4-wire dryer outlet and a vehicle large enough for transport. Happy to assist with loading it!
meta_description: Pre-owned GE 7.4 cu. ft. smart electric dryer (Model GTD72EBPN0DG) in good condition. Features Wi-Fi SmartHQ monitoring, HE Sensor Dry, Sanitize Cycle, and reversible door.
name_zh: 通用家电 GE 7.4立方英尺 智能大容量家用电动烘干机
description_zh: 高效轻松搞定全家衣物洗涤的高配烘干神器！这款原装通用家电 GE 智能电动烘干机拥有 7.4 Cu. Ft. 惊人内部大容量，能轻松塞下整套高档床上四件套、大毛毯或厚重冬衣。配备先进的 HE 双热敏Sensor Dry智能湿度感应技术，衣干即停，完美防止衣物过热缩水。自带99.8%杀菌除螨烘干模式（Sanitize）、一键抗皱（Wrinkle Care）及内置 Wi-Fi 芯片，可使用手机 SmartHQ App 远程控制查看进度。高级钻石灰色外观（Diamond Gray），机身纤薄平整贴墙，省空间，运转安静且极为省电。
